先了解您的基础情况
Margaret Chen, female, 71 years old. Diagnosed with hypertension (8 years), type 2 diabetes (4 years), hyperlipidemia. Post-surgery recovery (knee replacement, 6 weeks ago). Medications: amlodipine 5mg qd, metformin 500mg bid, atorvastatin 20mg qn. Lives alone, daughter visits weekly.
📈
近期趋势
这段时间身体有什么变化
Over the past 14 days: appetite noticeably decreased, likely related to metformin side effects and post-surgery discomfort. Steps dropped from average 4,000/day to about 1,500/day. Blood pressure stable around 138/85. Blood glucose slightly elevated at 7.0-7.4 fasting. Reports feeling tired and not wanting to eat much.

Margaret，您正在从膝关节手术中恢复，同时还要管理高血压和糖尿病。现在的重点是减少恶心、保证一点点营养摄入，并用温和活动帮助身体恢复。

🧂
继续保持低盐饮食
→ 您的血压仍在偏高范围，少盐能帮助降压药发挥作用。
🫒
用蒸、煮、炖替代油炸
→ 清淡软烂的食物更适合恶心和食欲下降时入口，也更有利于血脂控制。
💧
少量多次喝温水
→ 补水有助于代谢药物，也可能缓解二甲双胍相关的不适。
